items.prompt: One single continuous close shot on an early-spring Hokkaido forest trail: a Japanese man's hand in a grey jacket sleeve slowly tightens its grip on a Japanese nata hatchet with a broad rectangular blade; a faint rustle in the bamboo grass, and the hand lifts the hatchet a little. The camera stays close on the hand and forearm, no face ever visible. No cuts, no scene change. No snow anywhere. 8 seconds. Photorealistic, shot on RED camera. Documentary style.
